Title: Study Cafe: Pomodoro Timer
Short description: Pomodoro-timer en studietimer: verdien punte, bou reekse, laat kafee groei.
Full description:
Study Cafe is a free Pomodoro timer app and study timer for Android with a cozy, aesthetic cafe theme. Focus for 25 minutes, take a 5-minute break, and earn points that grow your own virtual cafe. It is made for students, remote workers and anyone who wants to stay focused and build a daily study habit.

WHAT IS THE POMODORO TECHNIQUE?
The Pomodoro technique splits work into short focus sessions with breaks in between. In Study Cafe a focus session lasts 25 minutes, a short break lasts 5 minutes, and after every 4 focus sessions you get a 15-minute long break. The timer switches between them for you.

WHY STUDY CAFE?
- Focus timer with automatic focus, short break and long break sessions
- Points for every finished session, spent on treats for your virtual cafe: espresso, green tea and cheesecake
- Daily streaks and achievements that reward consistent studying
- Calming ambient sounds while you study: rain, fireplace and brown noise
- Statistics: see your study time by week, month and all time
- Optional leaderboard: sign in with email or Google to compare points with other students
- Session-end reminders, even when the app is in the background
- Share your progress as a card with friends
- Available in English and Turkish

QUICK ANSWERS
Is Study Cafe free? Yes. It is free and supported by ads. An optional rewarded ad gives bonus points.
Do I need an account? No. The timer, cafe, streaks, sounds and statistics work without one. An account is only needed for the leaderboard.
Who is it for? Students preparing for exams, people doing deep work, and anyone who wants a simple focus timer for studying or working.
Which languages are supported? English and Turkish.
How do I delete my account? Open Profile > Delete Account, or follow https://cynorra.github.io/studycafe/delete-account.html

Privacy policy: https://cynorra.github.io/studycafe/privacy.html
Contact: eren.gp54@gmail.com

WHAT IS THE POMODORO TECHNIQUE?
The Pomodoro technique splits work into short focus sessions with breaks in between. In Study Cafe a focus session lasts 25 minutes, a short break lasts 5 minutes, and after every 4 focus sessions you get a 15-minute long break. The timer switches between them for you.

WHY STUDY CAFE?
- Focus timer with automatic focus, short break and long break sessions
- Points for every finished session, spent on treats for your virtual cafe: espresso, green tea and cheesecake
- Daily streaks and achievements that reward consistent studying
- Calming ambient sounds while you study: rain, fireplace and brown noise

- Share your progress as a card with friends
- Available in English and Turkish

QUICK ANSWERS
Is Study Cafe free? Yes. It is free and supported by ads. An optional rewarded ad gives bonus points.
Do I need an account? No. The timer, cafe, streaks, sounds and statistics work without one. An account is only needed for the leaderboard.
Who is it for? Students preparing for exams, people doing deep work, and anyone who wants a simple focus timer for studying or working.
Which languages are supported? English and Turkish.

Title: Study Cafe: Pomodoro Sayacı
Short description: Pomodoro timer ve ders çalışma sayacı. Puan kazan, seri yap, kafeni büyüt.
Full description:
Study Cafe, Android için ücretsiz bir pomodoro timer uygulaması (pomodoro sayacı) ve ders çalışma zamanlayıcısıdır. 25 dakika odaklan, 5 dakika mola ver ve kazandığın puanlarla kendi sanal kafeni büyüt. Öğrenciler, uzaktan çalışanlar ve odaklanmak, günlük çalışma alışkanlığı kazanmak isteyen herkes için tasarlandı.

POMODORO TEKNİĞİ NEDİR?
Pomodoro tekniği, işi aralarda molalar olan kısa odaklanma seanslarına böler. Study Cafe'de bir odaklanma seansı 25 dakika, kısa mola 5 dakika sürer; her 4 odaklanma seansından sonra 15 dakikalık uzun mola gelir. Sayaç seanslar arasında senin yerine geçiş yapar.

NEDEN STUDY CAFE?
- Odaklanma, kısa mola ve uzun mola seanslarını otomatik değiştiren pomodoro saati
- Biten her seans için puan; puanlarla sanal kafen için espresso, yeşil çay ve cheesecake al
- Düzenli çalışmayı ödüllendiren günlük seriler ve başarımlar
- Çalışırken sakinleştiren ortam sesleri: yağmur, şömine ve kahverengi gürültü
- İstatistikler: çalışma süreni haftalık, aylık ve tüm zamanlar için gör
- İsteğe bağlı liderlik tablosu: e-posta veya Google ile giriş yap, puanlarını diğer öğrencilerle karşılaştır
- Uygulama arka plandayken bile seans sonu hatırlatıcıları
- İlerlemeni kart olarak arkadaşlarınla paylaş
- Türkçe ve İngilizce dil desteği

KISA CEVAPLAR
Study Cafe ücretsiz mi? Evet. Ücretsizdir ve reklamlarla desteklenir. İsteğe bağlı ödüllü reklam bonus puan verir.
Hesap açmam gerekir mi? Hayır. Sayaç, kafe, seriler, sesler ve istatistikler hesapsız çalışır. Hesap yalnızca liderlik tablosu için gerekir.
Kimler için? Sınavlara hazırlanan öğrenciler, derin çalışma yapanlar ve ders çalışmak ya da çalışmak için basit bir odaklanma sayacı isteyen herkes.
Hangi diller destekleniyor? Türkçe ve İngilizce.
Hesabımı nasıl silerim? Profil > Hesabı Sil bölümünden veya https://cynorra.github.io/studycafe/delete-account-tr.html adresinden.

Full description:
Study Cafe — безкоштовний помодоро-таймер і таймер для навчання на Android в затишному стилі кафе. Зосередься на 25 хвилин, відпочинь 5 хвилин і заробляй бали для віртуального кафе.

- Щоденні серії та досягнення
- Заспокійливі звуки: дощ, камін і коричневий шум
- Статистика за тиждень, місяць і весь час
- Необов’язковий акаунт (пошта або Google) для таблиці лідерів

Title: Study Cafe: Pomodoro Timer
Short description: Isibali se-Pomodoro: thola amaphuzu, gcina uchungechunge, khulisa ikhefi.
Full description:
Study Cafe is a free Pomodoro timer app and study timer for Android with a cozy, aesthetic cafe theme. Focus for 25 minutes, take a 5-minute break, and earn points that grow your own virtual cafe. It is made for students, remote workers and anyone who wants to stay focused and build a daily study habit.

WHAT IS THE POMODORO TECHNIQUE?
The Pomodoro technique splits work into short focus sessions with breaks in between. In Study Cafe a focus session lasts 25 minutes, a short break lasts 5 minutes, and after every 4 focus sessions you get a 15-minute long break. The timer switches between them for you.

WHY STUDY CAFE?
- Focus timer with automatic focus, short break and long break sessions
- Points for every finished session, spent on treats for your virtual cafe: espresso, green tea and cheesecake
- Daily streaks and achievements that reward consistent studying
- Calming ambient sounds while you study: rain, fireplace and brown noise
- Statistics: see your study time by week, month and all time
- Optional leaderboard: sign in with email or Google to compare points with other students
- Session-end reminders, even when the app is in the background
- Share your progress as a card with friends
- Available in English and Turkish

QUICK ANSWERS
Is Study Cafe free? Yes. It is free and supported by ads. An optional rewarded ad gives bonus points.
Do I need an account? No. The timer, cafe, streaks, sounds and statistics work without one. An account is only needed for the leaderboard.
Who is it for? Students preparing for exams, people doing deep work, and anyone who wants a simple focus timer for studying or working.
Which languages are supported? English and Turkish.
How do I delete my account? Open Profile > Delete Account, or follow https://cynorra.github.io/studycafe/delete-account.html
